title: The Midnight Muddle at Paws Fair
intro: Every morning the adoption fair's kennels are found a little messier, and someone has been sneaking in after dark to play with the puppies.

suspects.name: Grace
suspects.line: I was in the parking lot, honest.

suspects.name: Tomas
suspects.line: Night shifts are long. I needed a walk.

suspects.name: Maya
suspects.line: I only came to look at the bunnies, I swear.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was reading by the cat tent all evening.

suspects.name: Leo
suspects.line: Dogs don't like me. Ask any of them.

clues.text: A red beanie was caught on the coat hook near the door. The night visitor was wearing a red beanie when they slipped in.
Nobody with a bald, shiny head was in the booth at the time. The visitor could not have been someone bald and shiny, so that look is ruled out.
The sign-in sheet shows the cat tent was empty all night. The culprit was not in the cat tent, so that spot is ruled out.
A muddy paw print was left on the gate latch. Whoever came through here had a muddy paw print on their boot, not a clean one.
